fee_notes: Reduced fee of $25,000 for existing franchisees of affiliated brands in good standing. 10% veteran discount available. $9,500 deposit credited toward fee. Multi-unit development fee is $49,500 for first center plus $25,000 per additional center.
raw_excerpt: When you sign your Franchise Agreement, you must pay IA an initial franchise fee amount to $49,500 (the "Initial Franchise Fee").
